g.text: Sequence Diagram - AA03 Role Resolution after Login (local login + loading the current roles in the SPA)
Local login is shown (AA01). External login (AA02) ends in the same
UserService.assertCanAccess() + issueAuthToken() and then in the same part 2.
Wrong credentials keep the generic AA01 failure (401 "Invalid email or password").
Every error branch ENDS the interaction: no token is issued or stored and /auth/me is never called.
All errors use the errorHandler format { error: { message, status } }.
1. Authentication (no role is accepted from the request)
{ error: { message: "Invalid email or password", status: 401 } }
{ error: { message: "Account is not active", status: 403 } }
interaction ends: no token stored, /auth/me not called;
throw AppError("No active role is assigned
{ error: { message: "No active role is assigned to this account", status: 403 } }
interaction ends: no token stored, /auth/me not called;
[B3) Active account with at least one role]
roles and active state are unchanged.
2. Only after B3: the SPA obtains the CURRENT internal roles from the back end
token + account checks detailed in SD 3
[C) resolveActor fails (invalid token, user deleted, inactive, no role, roles not confirmable)]
The account is re-validated on the instance
that is returned: it may have been deleted,
deactivated or left without roles after
{ error: { message: "Invalid or expired token", status: 401 } }
{ error: { message: "Account is not active", status: 403 } }
throw AppError("No active role is assigned
{ error: { message: "No active role is assigned to this account", status: 403 } }
3. The SPA validates the answer before showing any protected functionality
Valid only if: id is a "USR-" string, email and name are strings,
roles is a non-empty array of DISTINCT values from
Roles are never decoded from the JWT and
never selected by the user. A user with several
roles sees the union of their sections.
[E1b) Body malformed (missing / unknown / duplicated roles, active != true, ...)]
"We could not confirm your permissions. Please sign in again."
"We could not confirm your permissions. Please sign in again."
